ShipModule.Name: Dominion Jem'Hadar Hull Plate (Medium)
ShipModule.Description: Heavy plate for the warships of the Jem'Hadar, who were bred for war and count comfort a weakness. "Remember: victory is life." (First Omet'iklan, DS9: "To the Death") Gives almost no protection against fire; it is there to soak up damage. Of the Dominion ship plates of its size, it is the cheapest to build and the easiest to repair, but the most fragile.
